messages:
Aria: Heads-up  were prepping the QBR for AtlasEdge (renewal ~5w). Need a 90s exec ask + a one-pager risk brief. Who can pick slides? :wave:
Ben: Ill own the 90s ask and speaker script. Will pull ARR exposure and the conservative ask lanes.
Rina: Ill do onboarding health. Current completion 71% with 2 blocked SSO flows; will add owner/action.
Omar: Noted uptick in support volume after recent model swap. Renewal risk now 0.46. Main asks: clearer tuning docs and a billing SKU map.
Aria: @Omar can you paste two anonymized support quotes we can use on the brief?
Omar: Snippets: "Responses sometimes lose context after token limit change" and "We need explicit tuning recipes for low-cost models."
Sahil: Ill assemble the one-pager + action tracker. Need a short SLA blurb  @Ben can you drop the Console summary?
Ben: SLA excerpt: `Q2 incidents: infra=2, perf=2; avg MTTR=2.6h; severity1=0`. Uploading full CSV to Drive.
EBR-bot: Reminder: QBR dry run scheduled Wed 9:30am PT  invites sent to execs and AMs.
Aria: Slide constraints: keep it to max 3 slides. Include fallback options: concierge support + Dedicated evaluation (cost delta). Bring two mitigations per risk to dry run.
Rina: Confirmed. Ill post onboarding slide by 2pm with TTF and blocked item owners.
Omar: Confirmed  will add the anonymized quotes and NPS snippet.
Sahil: Confirmed  will template the tracker and assign due dates.
Ben: Confirmed  will add ARR numbers to the ask slide and share drive link.
Aria: Thanks team  final note: include whos speaking for which section in the slide notes. See you at the dry run. :calendar:
